title: Moved by Compassion
summaryZh: 貼近他人的困境能喚醒我們的憐憫之心，並讓生命充滿神所賜的使命感。
lines: I have a friend who works on the streets of Compton, near LA, sharing Jesus with teenagers.
我有一位朋友在洛杉磯附近的康普頓街頭工作，向青少年分享耶穌。
Their stories are crazy and so is the impact he’s having.
他們的故事非常不可思議，而他所帶來的影響力也是如此。
I was on the phone with him the other day and he brought up the story of the Good Samaritan.
前幾天我和他通電話時，他提到了好撒馬利亞人的故事。
Jewish guy gets beat up and left on the road.
一個猶太人被打，並被丟在路邊。
Priests pass by on the other side.
Levite passed by on the other side.
利未人也從另一邊走過去。
They stayed far enough away to avoid feeling too bad about it all.
他們保持著足夠的距離，以免對這一切感到太內疚。
"But a Samaritan, as he traveled, came where the man was."
「惟有一個撒馬利亞人行路來到那裡。」
"And when he saw him, he took pity on him."
This story has taken on more significance since my friend moved so close to the brokenness.
自從我朋友如此貼近這些破碎的生命後，這個故事變得更具意義。
He can’t help but do something about what he sees.
看到這一切，他忍不住要採取一些行動。
貼近人群能喚醒我們的憐憫。
Jesus said the Good Samaritan was being a good neighbor.
耶穌說，這個好撒馬利亞人做了一個好鄰舍。
I think the Jewish guy probably saw him as a hero.
我想那個猶太人可能把他視為英雄。
My friend is a neighbor/hero in the lives of these young people because he got close enough for his compassion to wake up.
我的朋友成為了這些年輕人生命中的鄰舍與英雄，因為他足夠靠近，喚醒了他的憐憫。
I can promise you that as his compassion moves him to action, his life is bursting with purpose.
我可以向你保證，當他的憐憫驅使他採取行動時，他的生命便充滿了使命感。
So if you find yourself wondering if your life matters these days, might I challenge you to get close enough to someone’s trouble to wake up your compassion and move you to action?
因此，如果你最近在想自己的生命是否有意義，我可否挑戰你去貼近某人的困境，來喚醒你的憐憫並驅使你採取行動？
It’s what Jesus did for us when He left heaven, getting close enough to see just how much we needed a hero, too.
這正是耶穌為我們所做的，當祂離開天上，足夠靠近地看見我們也是多麼需要一位英雄。
